mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 105.0) creates production bottlenecks that reduce corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 105.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payroll growth above 140,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS remains above 140,000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,250 thousand units indicate a robust housing market that stimulates consumer spending and business investment, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST exceeds 1,250 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 0.5% and CPIAUCSL levels above 230.0 signal aggressive monetary tightening amid high inflation, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 230.0 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 450,000 million dollars signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS exceeds 450,000 for 3 consecutive months but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of such periods.
